definitions.gloss: urban area; city area; metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: The urbanized part of a region, as opposed to rural areas. Used in news, statistics, and policy discussions to refer to cities and their surrounding developed zones.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}は{家賃|やちん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Rent is high in urban areas.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}が{都市部|としぶ}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}している。
examples.english: The population is concentrated in urban areas.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}と{地方|ちほう}では{生活|せいかつ}のスタイルが{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Lifestyles differ greatly between urban areas and rural regions.

notes:
Frequently contrasted with {地方|ちほう} (rural regions) or {郊外|こうがい} (suburbs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市部|としぶ}に{住|す}む (to live in an urban area)
- {都市部|としぶ}の{人口|じんこう} (urban population)
- {大|おお}{都市部|としぶ} (major metropolitan area)
- {都市部|としぶ}と{地方|ちほう} (urban and rural areas)
